description: Fetch readable web content/docs/PDFs from public URLs. Auto-cleans ads, keeps code/tables. Batch urls (1-3), CSS selector scoping, bm25 focus, startIndex paging, cache, schema extract to JSON, citations, link retention.

cache.description: Cache mode: 'default' uses disk Markdown cache; 'reload' forces re-fetching upstream

citations.description: Rewrite inline links as numbered citations and append a '## References' list, so the answer can cite sources

extract.description: Extract structured JSON instead of markdown, using CSS selectors — no LLM needed. fields: [{name, selector, type: text|html|markdown|attribute|list, attribute?, fields?, all?}]; selector '@attr' reads an attribute of the current node

focus.description: Keyword or section name to target (e.g. 'Auth', 'Config'); returns targeted window (~5000 chars) instead of burning tokens on full document

focusMode.description: How focus selects text: 'bm25' (default) ranks paragraphs by relevance and keeps the best ones; 'window' keeps the old ±2500-char window around the first match

format.description: Content format (default: 'markdown' when raw is false): 'markdown' preserves headings, lists, fenced code blocks (with language) and GFM tables — better for technical docs; use 'text' for plain text

raw.description: Return the raw response body (HTML/plain text) without extraction

retainLinks.description: Inline link retention: 'all' (default) keeps [label](url); 'text' keeps only the label (strips URLs, big win on index/list pages); 'none' removes the link entirely. Ignored inside code blocks

selector.description: CSS selector: return only the matched subtree, keeping code blocks and tables. Use when auto-extraction grabs the wrong container. Errors instead of silently returning the whole page when nothing matches

startIndex.description: Character offset to start reading from (for paging through long content)

urls.description: Batch URLs (1~3 URLs run concurrently, splitting maxChars budget; ideal for comparing search results)

name: fetchWebContent
